subject: Error in library(topicmodels) : there is no package called ‘topicmodels’

messages.subject: Error in library(topicmodels) : there is no package called ‘topicmodels’
parts:
I am creating a shiny app in RStudio, where i am implementing topic modelling which requires the package "topicmodels".

I installed it using : install.packages("topicmodels") and it gets installed successfully.

But when i try to run my app which includes library(topicmodels) , it shows the error  :: Error in library(topicmodels) : there is no package called ‘topicmodels’

After searching a lot i came to know that i should install gsl package too , even after successful installation of gsl , i am geeting the same error.


please help me out with this.  I need it to be working urgently 

Thanks in advance
